    fulfilment_channel,
    forward_transporter
FROM
    zs_observe.increff_returns

    group_level_id = 22 AND
    is_active = true AND
    order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND
    transaction_type = 'RETURN'
ORDER BY
    fulfilment_channel, forward_transporter;
